column7: admin_dsn is project-admin input but only its host was checked: mysql allowAllFiles=true let a rogue server pull any local file through LOCAL INFILE (reproduced against MySQLEngine.Issue), mongodb authMechanism=MONGODB-OIDC/MONGODB-AWS/GSSAPI made the driver present the server's ambient credentials (pod SA token, cloud metadata tokens) to the target host, and mongodb tls*File / postgres sslrootcert,sslcert,sslkey,passfile,servicefile,service made the driver read server paths. dsn.CheckLocalFileOptions now refuses them at config create and in each engine before the driver parses the DSN. Red before the change (the rogue server received the file), green after. Class guard: TestLocalFileOptionsCoverTheDrivers.
